title: Reidai Bridge　霊台橋　英字幕付き　美里町観光PR動画
description:
This is a Misato Town tourism PR video created in 2025.

This is a gigantic stone bridge with a total length of 90 meters that spans Funatsu Gorge, the most difficult point on the main stream of the Midori River. It is one of the largest single stone arches in Japan from the Edo period. It is a nationally designated important cultural property that was built in 1847 (4th year of Koka) by the three Taneyama mason brothers Usuke, Uichi, and Johachi.

◇HP　http://misato.town/spot.html?id=80

title: Japan's tallest stone steps, 3333 steps　日本一の石段　3333段　釈迦院御坂遊歩道　英字幕付き　美里町観光PR動画
description:
This is a Misato Town tourism PR video created in 2025.

These stone steps were built in Misaka, the main approach to the historic Shaka-in Temple (Izumi-cho, Yatsushiro City), which has a history of 1,200 years, and are the largest in Japan.They will be preserved for future generations as a century-old cultural heritage and will revitalize the town. It was built with the aim of creating a tourist attraction and a symbol of town revitalization.
Construction of the stone steps began in January 1980, and in November 1986, it surpassed the 2,446 steps of Mt. Haguro in Yamagata Prefecture to become the number one in Japan in both name and reality, and was completed at the end of March 1986.
In addition to famous stones from all over the country, these stone steps use granite from countries around the world such as China, South Korea, India, the former Soviet Union, Brazil, the United States, and South Africa.They are used to build international goodwill and friendship, and to promote historical exploration and health. It is used as a tourist and recreational facility.
Additionally, Attack the Nihon Ichi is held every November using the stone steps.
Some early climbers may take less than an hour to complete the climb, but for the general public, please expect it to take about 3 hours, including 2 hours for the ascent and 1 hour for the descent.


◇HP　http://misato.town/spot.html?id=68

title: Hiking in Japan - Sacred Peak Mt. Hakkai 八海山 | Adventures in Yukiguni | Minamiuonuma
description:
Climbing Mt. Hakkai (1778 m) of the Echigo Sanzan Mountains. Using the Hakkaisan Ropeway the hike took about 7 hours round-trip. 

Many tourists flock to Snow Country in the winter months to hit the slopes, but many of these snow resort grounds continue to attract visitors seeking outdoor adventures through mountain climbing in the summer as well. 

Mt. Hakkai is a famous mountain in Minamiuonuma that boasts a long history of dedicated climbers coming from all across the country. There are two impressive shrines dedicated to the mountain at each trail-head, and the mountain's delicious spring water and impressive shape are part of the reason its name has become one of Japan's most reputable sake brands: Hakkaisan. The mountain is very popular for tourists hiking on summer break and its lookout decks offer beautiful views of the varicolored Uonuma Basin in autumn once the leaves begin to change too. The mountains in this region are said to bless the locals with many gifts and in the green season these are manifested in the landscape's breathtaking scenery.


Hakkaisan Ropeway Info: https://www.tohokukanko.jp/en/attractions/detail_1784.html
Visit Minamiuonuma: https://www.facebook.com/visitminamiuonuma/

title: octagon tunnel 　熊延鉄道遺構　八角トンネル　英字幕付き　美里町観光PR動画
description:
This is a Misato Town tourism PR video created in 2025.

It is one of the remains of the Kumanobe Railway, which opened in April 1912 in Minami Kumamoto Station (Kumamoto City) and later extended to Toyo, Shimomashiki District (Misato Town), running for a total length of 28.6 km.
The line was discontinued in 1962, but even now, about 60 years later, this octagonal tunnel, which was built to prevent the rocks on both sides of the track from collapsing, still welcomes many tourists as an industrial ruin. I am.
A leading theory is that the reason why the seven towers are connected, with gaps between them, making it an imperfect shape for rockfall protection, is to reduce construction costs. It is a ruin with many mysteries.
Also, nearby are the piers of the Tsurugawa Bridge, which are also the remains of the Kumanobe Railway, and are valuable remains of the Kumanobe Railway, which supported industrial development in the past.

description:
This is a Misato Town tourism PR video created in 2025.

roadside station Misato "Samata-no-Yu" is a roadside station where the hot springs flowing directly from the source soothe the mind and body.

title: 遊山箱-ＹＵＳＡＮＢＡＫＯ-［Tokushima］
description:
Tokushima has been producing lumber for a very long time.  High quality lumber processing technique of shipwrights used to serve the powerful navy of Awa-Han (feudal domain/a part of present Tokushima) greatly in the Edo Period (1603–1868), and the technique has been passed down through the generations.

A carpentry skill called Mokuhari (thin wood sheet craft) is utilized and beautiful paintwork is applied to Yusanbako.  It is a three-tiered box that used to be used as a lunch box for leisure in fields and mountains, and Doll’s Festivals.

title: Mt. Io:Untouched Hokkaido/硫黄山
description:
Teshikaga Town: Mt. Io

Stand inches away from the pulse of the earth
With the distinctive smell of sulfur and alpine plants at much lower altitudes than they usually grow, Mt. Io is like a scene from another planet. Mt. Io is located around 3km from Kawayu Hot Springs, and is called Atosa-nupuri (bare mountain) in Ainu. To this day, sulfur plumes rise from various areas of the mountain, with an incredible rumbling sound. Large-scale sulfur mining once took place here, which played a significant role in Teshikaga Town's development.
Parking is free during the winter (late November to early April).
Parking fees apply during summer: \200 for a motorcycle, \500 for a car, \1,000 for a minibus, \2,000 for a large bus
*Mt. Io is currently closed to the public for safety reasons, as there is currently a risk of falling rocks.

Untouched Hokkaido
Eastern Hokkaido has a history and geography all of its own. Despite its location in Japan, it is actually on the North American tectonic plate, and as a result it is full of extremely rare plant life. Eastern Hokkaido locals have coexisted for generations with the area's rare wildlife and the nature in the national parks that those animals call home, and as a result there are many natural areas that are untouched by human hands.

title: Hike along the Akan River:Untouched Hokkaido/阿寒川リバーサイドハイク
description:
You’ll be hard-pressed to find a more beautiful hiking spot than this tranquil river surrounded by forest with natural hot springs along the way
The pure waters of the Akan River are home to rainbow trout and whitespotted char. In winter, you can hike on snowshoes through the snow-covered forest by the river. Hot springs can be found along the river, making the perfect end point for your hike. If the timing is right, you might even see wildlife such as foxes, raccoon dogs (tanuki) and Yezo deer, which drink from the hot springs to get minerals.

"Where water kamuy and fire kamuy meet"
The indigenous Ainu people of Hokkaido place great importance on coexisting with nature, where they believe that deities reside. There are two types of deities in nature – the deity of fire  (apefuchi-kamuy) and the deity of water (wakkaushi-kamuy). The Akan River is a holy ground where the two meet, and the two types of kamuy are believed to provide the nutrients that the forest wildlife lives on.

title: Kotan no Yu: A free open-air hot spring by Lake Kussharo/Untouched Hokkaido/コタンの湯
description:
This natural open-air hot spring bath will make you feel like you’re bathing in Lake Kussharo itself
This hot spring bath surrounded by stones is just 5m from Lake Kussharo, creating the illusion that you are bathing in Lake Kussharo itself. In winter, the warm water runs into the lake, attracting swans that you can see right before your eyes. As you look out over the lake, you'll feel as if the swans are bathing in the hot spring with you. This vast natural paradise is stunningly beautiful no matter what time of day you visit, with incredible sunsets over the mountains beyond the lake and stars as far as the eye can see at night. Admission is free and free parking is available. Basic men's and women's changing facilities are available. The bath is surrounded by stones. While there is a large stone in the center dividing the bath in two, each side is visible from the other side, so bathing is basically mixed. Swimwear is OK.

Address
〒088-3341
Kotan Onsen open-air bath, 541 Kussharo, Teshikaga-chō, Kawakami-gun, Hokkaidō

title: Early morning tour of Lake Akan in winter:Untouched Hokkaido/冬の阿寒湖早朝散歩
description:
Take an early morning tour through the snowy scenery around Lake Akan
In winter, you can explore a freezing natural environment where it is not uncommon for early morning temperatures to reach -20°C. The winter chill creates magical natural beauty. You can walk across the completely frozen Akan lake to its island in around 10 minutes. You can also see the sunrise over Mt. Oakan and beautiful natural phenomena such as frost flowers, rime and diamond dust. The tour meets at 6:20, early mornings from late January to mid-March.
In summer, this island can only be reached by boat.

title: Fukutsukasa Sake:Untouched Hokkaido/釧路の地酒 福司酒造
description:
Fukutsukasa is a brewery that has made seishu sake in Kushiro since 1919.
Fukutsukasa is one of Kushiro's best-known brands. Its name is said to come from fuku wo tsukasadoru, an ancient Japanese concept of inviting good fortune. As Kushiro's only sake brewery, Fukutsukasa makes delicious sake that cannot be imitated elsewhere, and is a firm favorite among Kushiro locals. The main ingredient is Hokkaido rice, brewed in groundwater filtered by the great nature of eastern Hokkaido.

title: Untouched Hokkaido ダイジェスト(Winter)
description:
Welcome to Eastern Hokkaido, an incredibly beautiful area filled with rare wildlife and natural wonders.
The area is blessed with an abundance of pure, natural water that transforms the landscape throughout the seasons. 

Sarorun Kamuy
The Kushiro area is home to the natural habitat of the red-crowned crane, a designated special natural monument that was once called “sarorun kamuy”, which means “spirits that live in the marshlands”, by the native Ainu people.

Cape Kirakotan
Cape Kirakotan is a designated national natural monument area, and its name originates from when the marshland was still part of the ocean, 6 thousand years ago. It was found to be a natural breeding ground of the red crowned crane that was previously thought to be extinct.

Sunset Cruise
Kushiro is said to have one of the three most beautiful sunsets in the world, and the best place to see it is from a boat. 

Robatayaki
Robatayaki is a style of cooking that is unique to the port town of Kushiro, and these restaurants are the perfect place to enjoy amazing food and delicious sake with friendly locals.

Sake : Fukutsukasa
Established in 1919, Fukutsukasa sake brewery blends delicious local spring water with the finest natural ingredients to create a wide variety of sakes.

Snowshoeing
Snowshoeing along the banks of Akan River brings you to a natural oasis that attracts many wild animals, a mystical place where the Ainu believed the spirits of fire and water coexist.

Ainu Culture
Ainu are the indigenous people of Hokkaido, who believe that spirits exist in nature. The culture and customs of the Ainu people remain strong in the Akan region.

Lake Kussharo
Lake Kussharo is the largest caldera lake in Japan and is home to a large number of wild swans that keep warm through the harsh winter near the natural hot springs.

Mt. Iou
Mt. Iou vents plumes of sulfurous steam through volcanic craters in the mountain side, creating a strong smell of sulfur in the surrounding area. 

Kawayu Hot Spring
Hotels in Kawayu Onsen area draw their hot spring water from the same pure source, so abundant that even the river that flows through the town stems from natural volcanic springs.

Lake Mashu
The lake water is so pure it is said to be the second clearest water in the world, and the lake surface has a distinctively beautiful color known as Mashu blue.

title: Okayama 岡山｜JAPAN - Kitagi-shima island! -
description:
Let’s go cycling around a Japan Heritage, Kitagi-shima Island, also known as “Stone Island” to experience thrilling lookout and stunning rock views. 
It is a one-hour ferry ride to the island while looking out to the beautiful Seto Inland Sea. You can fully enjoy the island even in a day trip. It offers a plenty of attractive spots such as sceneries reminding of Guilin or Venice, and spectacular quarry sites! 

9:25 Board  ferry departing from Fushigoe-ko Port, Kasaoka 
Single ticket: JPY 550/person 
　　↓
10:28 Arrival at Toyoura-ko Port, Kitagishima (Kitagi Island) 　
　　↓Rent a bike at K’s LABO, JPY 800 each for 3-8 hour use 
Highlight: Photo spot 
　　↓20 minutes on the rented bike 
Lunch: Ramen noodle at “Minatoya” restaurant 
Highlight: Enjoy an exclusive Ramen with “Kamenote” broth! The restaurant serves Ramen using that the stock is taken with “Kamenote” , a kind of or Japanese goose barnacle (scientific name: Capitulum mitella) for the broth. The unique name “kamenote” comes from its similarity with turtles’ paws (Japanese names for: turtle=Kame and, paw=Te). 
　　↓20 minutes on the rented bike
Visit to Hikari Cinema, a former movie theater
　　↓1 minute on the rented bike
Ishikiri no Tani (Stonecutting Valley) viewpoint
Admission fee: JPY 1,000/person（Hours: 12:00-13:00 on weekdays and 11:00-13:00 on Saturday, Sunday and public holidays)
　　↓5 minutes on the rented bike
“Venice” of the Kitagi 
Highlight: Photo spot
　　↓
“Guilin” of the Kitagi 
Highlight: Photo spot
　　↓
Return bikes to K’s LABO and have a break at the café 
Highlight: Ocean view café 
　　↓5 minute walk 
“Möbius strip” stone sculpture
Highlight: Photo spot
　　↓5 minute walk
16:26 Board ferry departing from Toyoura-ko Port, Kitagishima (Kitagi Island) 
Single ticket: JPY 550/ person
　　↓
17:26 Arrival at Fushigoe-ko Port, Kasaoka

title: Okayama 岡山｜JAPAN -  NEW Okayama Castle！-
description:
Major Renovations During Reiwa and renewal opened November 3rd this year as Castle That Informs Of History And Castle Where People Gather.
The castle's black exterior walls, its major feature, were repainted. The castle offers visitors interesting and informative exhibitions that show the history of Okayama through videos and experience programs. The castle tower's floors from B1 to 6th floors, except 2nd floor where important cultural properties are exhibited, can be rented in the evening for parties or other activities.
In this video, we give you the charm of the entire Okayama Castle and experience making Bizen-yaki pottery at Okayama Castle Bizen-yaki Pottery Studio.

title: Residence and Tulip Garden Public Viewing | チューリップガーデンEmbassy of the Netherlands in Japan
description:
#happydutchspring2022 #nlinjapan #tulips #netherlandsandyou #netherlandsinjapan

The Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Japan hosted a Residence and Tulip Garden Public Viewing last April 8 and 10, Friday and Sunday respectively. This is in view of welcoming the Dutch Spring this year, which features 70 kinds of tulips, the largest number ever.

“Tulips, the national flower of the Netherlands, along with other flowers, are a major export industry of the Netherlands. It is said that about 80% of the world's tulip fields are in the Netherlands. This year, the Ambassador's residence is decorated with about 13,000 tulips of 70 varieties, the largest number ever imported from the Netherlands.”- nlinjp.com

It is our pleasure to have joined and witnessed this event and we are pleased to share with you some of the lovely photos and videos we have captured during the said event. 


A special Thank You to the Ambassador of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Japan for sharing and hosting this rare opportunity to the public. It is our pleasure to have seen these Tulip varieties in your Residence giving us the Netherlands’ spring feels while in Japan.

title: Giant Halloween Pumpkins 2021 at Yumenoshima | Halloween Pumpkins | Halloween Party | ハロウィンパーティー2021
description:
#yumenoshimahalloweenparty2021 #halloweenpumpkins #halloweenintokyo #halloween2021

Welcome back to Yumenoshima tropical greenhouse dome. As you can see on our last posted video, Daddy and i were here and we enjoyed much with the tropical plants in the dome. And since Jt was not with us that day, we went back here today and we will be enjoying with the giant halloween pumpkins. 

An exhibition of these giant ghost pumpkins, which they call Yumenoshima halloween party, is celebrated and very popular every year. And since the halloween is just around the corner, this event is already happening right now. It started on the 22nd of September and will last until the 31st of October. 

They will exhibit more than 100 giant ghost pumpkins weighing 50 to 100 kilograms. Can you imagine how heavy and big is that? These giant pumpkins were made in Hitachiomiya City, in Ibaraki Prefecture, in connection with the Halloween. 

With an admission fee of 250 yen for each adult, you can roam around the greenhouse dome, learn and enjoy the tropical plants which you barely see everyday. Kids under 12 years old can enter free of charge. And for sure your toddlers will have fun with these giant ghost pumpkins all around the open garden. There will also be a photography area just inside the hall with the halloween backdrops. So you better grab your favorite halloween costumes and get ready for memorable photos.

You can also bring your own food and have a small picnic in the garden together with these ghost pumpkins, orrr, you can just go to the cafeteria inside the hall and grab any food of your choice.

Event Date and Hours: 
September 22– Sunday,Tuesday–Sunday  9:30 – 17:00 (Last entry 16:00). Closed on Monday. If Monday is a public holiday they will open and close on Tuesday.

Cost: Fees: Adults 250 yen, Ages 65 and older 120 yen, Ages 13–15 100 yen
Under 12 FREE!

Address: 2-1-2 Yumenoshima, Koto-ku
Phone: 03-3522-0281
Website: http://www.yumenoshima.jp/

Note: this is in Japanese language. You can use google chrome too as it has an automatic translator if you wish to view it in English.

Access: 10 minute walk from Shin-Kiba Station, which is 10 minutes from Tokyo Station on the Keiyo Line. Also accessible on the Yurakucho Line.

You can also access the Metro Tozai line’s Toyocho Station and take the Toei Bus going to Shinkiba, get off at the Yumenoshima Stop and from there you can walk 7mins to Greenhouse Dome.

Notes: Nursing room and Diaper changing table located in the Botanical Garden. Please ask the staff for directions.

title: Narusawa Ice Cave | Mt. Fuji Tour | 鳴沢氷穴 | Narusawa Hyōketsu
description:
#narusawa #narusawaicecave #mtfuji #yamanashi #japanadventures #touristsppotsinjapan #familyadventureinjapan

The Narusawa "Hyoketsu" Ice Cave is located at the east entrance to the Aokigahara Jukai "sea of trees" forest, and is regarded as one of the tourist spots within the Fuji Five Lakes area that can be visited throughout the year.
Over 1150 years ago, during year 6 of the Jogan era (864 a.d.), Nagaoyama, a flank volcano of Mt. Fuji erupted. The red hot lava flow (Aokigahara Maruo) descended between ancient parasitic volcanoes, creating this two-tunnel type cave. After being designated by the Ministry of Education as a natural monument in 1929, it was introduced to the world as a geological wonder.
By the way, the tree-type lava bed is said to have the most spiracles in the world.

Since the cave is situated in a ring-like manner, visitors can view its various features by making one circular loop.

The average temperature inside the cave is 3degC, that's why it is called an Ice Cave. The total length of the cave is 150m and requires 6-7 mins to have a complete view inside the cave.

title: Cherry Blossoms at Chidorigafuchi Ryokudo | 桜花見　千鳥ヶ淵緑道
description:
Artist#sakura #cherryblossoms #tokyo #chidorigafuchiryokudo #japan

This 700m promenade and park on the west side of the Imperial Palace is particularly impressive during cherry blossom season, when the around 250 sakura trees reach their heavy branches out over the Chidorigafuchi moat. Chidorigafuchi Boathouse, around the middle of the park, is where to rent a boat and paddle out over the water.

It is said that Chidorigafuchi was named because it has the shape of "Chidori". It used to be connected to Hanzo Moat, but it was reclaimed for road construction in 1883, and the moat was divided into two.Somei Yoshino cherry trees and wild cherry trees are planted on the banks of Chidorigafuchi and Hanzo moat, and together with the cherry blossoms of Chidorigafuchi Park managed by the 23 wards of the upper part of the bank, it is one of the most famous cherry blossom viewing spots in Tokyo.

Access:
Toei's Shinjuku Line - Kudanshita Station
Metro's Tozai Line - Kudanshita Station
Metro's Hanzomon Line - Hanzomon Station

description:
#fujisafaripark #fujizoo 

Fuji Safari Park

At the foot of Mt. Fuji lies this enormous animal park. Divided into 2 major zones, the Safari Zone and Fureai Zone. 

Safari Zone is a 50min drive through where you can find 7 zones of different animals from all over the world. Riding on your own car, you cannot open your windows or doors as it could be too dangerous. But there is an option of riding the Jungle Bus where you can feed the animals yourself. these huge animals come to the jungle bus seeking for food, as close as 20cm apart from you, with just steel mesh in between. You can also opt to try their 4WD vehicle and experience the same as the jungle bus, feed the animals as they come near you and wait to be fed.

The fureai zone on the other hand is extremely different as you can have a friendly contact with the animals. you can feed them upclose, hold them in your arms and caress them as long as you want. Great for kids and animal lovers. 

For more information, visit their website:
https://www.fujisafari.co.jp/en/

title: 【石川 観光】金沢寿司10選！
description:
石川県への旅行や観光で参考にしてください。
「加賀百万石」と言われるように、昔から食に文化に豊かな場所で、現在もそのきらびやかさが随所にみられる金沢。金沢は全国でも有数の、お寿司が美味しい場所でもあります。理由はなんといっても環境でしょう。金沢がある石川県は、白山や立山連峰に囲まれた土地柄、おいしい水が湧き出ていることで、おいしいお米が育ちます。また冷たい伏流水と栄養分いっぱいの水が流れ込む、穏やかな富山湾や能登半島の海。そして暖流と寒流が交わり豊富なえさ場になる、流れが激しく荒々しい能登沖の日本海。多様な海の環境のおかげで、種類豊富で新鮮な海産物が集まります。ほかにも地元のしょうゆなど、お寿司がおいしい条件が揃う金沢で、極上のお寿司をあじわってみませんか。

title: [Ishikawa Tourism] 10 Selected Kanazawa Sushi!
description:
Please use this as a reference for your trip or sightseeing in Ishikawa.
As it is said, "Kaga Hyakumangoku," Kanazawa has been a place rich in food and culture since ancient times, and its brilliance can still be seen everywhere today. Kanazawa is also one of the best places in Japan for delicious sushi. The reason is undoubtedly the environment. Ishikawa Prefecture, where Kanazawa is located, is surrounded by the Hakusan and Tateyama mountain ranges, providing delicious water that nurtures great rice. Additionally, the calm Toyama Bay and Noto Peninsula are fed by cold underground water and nutrient-rich streams. The Sea of Japan off the Noto Peninsula, where warm and cold currents meet, creates a rich feeding ground. Thanks to the diverse marine environment, a wide variety of fresh seafood gathers here. Why not savor exquisite sushi in Kanazawa, where all the conditions for delicious sushi, including local soy sauce, come together?

description:
"Shokaikyo" 
"Chikugo River Lift Bride (Former Chikugo River Bridge)"
This bridge was erected at the same time as the Japanese National Railways Saga Line was constructed in 1935. It is the oldest existing lift-type movable iron bridge in Japan. Now, it is open to the public as a walking trail. In 2007, it was also certified as a Mechanical Engineering Heritage site.

title: Svenska mangatecknaren Åsa kom till Okawa i Fukuoka Prefecture! "Koga Masao Memorial Hall"
description:
"Koga Masao Memorial Hall and Birthplace"
This memorial hall opened in 1982 to commemorate the great achievements of Masao Koga, a composer who was born in Okawa City and received the People's Honor Award. In the white building with a G clef, his beloved guitar, mandolin, and other musical instruments as well as numerous mementos are exhibited. He is said to have composed over 5,000 melodies. Here, you can enjoy his melodies through the facility's audio equipment.
Admission Fee: Adults 300yen, University and High school students 200yen, Junior high school and Elementary school students 100yen
Open :9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (The entrance gate closes at 4:30 p.m.)
Closed:Mondays(or the following day if Monday falls on a national holiday), New years holidays
Contact:TEL 0944-86-4133
"Fureai concert" is held by Koga Melody Guitar Ensemble at 10:00a.m. on the fourth Sunday every month.

title: 大淀ふれあいキャンプ場（三重県明和町）｜【公式】観光三重
description:
三重県明和町の海沿いに位置する大淀ふれあいキャンプ場は、美しい自然に囲まれアウトドアを満喫でき、海釣りも楽しめるおすすめのレジャースポット！
テントのほかにエアコン完備のバンガローやカーサイトもあるので、アウトドア初心者でも気軽にキャンプを楽しめます。
夏はキャンプ場の目の前にある真っ青な海で海水浴が大人気！遠浅で波も穏やかなため、子ども連れの海水浴にもぴったり。
バーベキュー食材セットも予約できます。
伊勢、鳥羽、志摩など三重県の人気観光地にも近く、家族の思い出つくりにオススメのキャンプ場です。

取材レポート：大淀ふれあいキャンプ場で海水浴や海釣りを楽しもう！アウトドア初心者でも気軽にキャンプを満喫できます！

title: Oyodo Fureai Campground (Meiwa Town, Mie Prefecture) | Official Tourism Mie
description:
Located along the coast in Meiwa Town, Mie Prefecture, Oyodo Fureai Campground is a recommended leisure spot where you can enjoy beautiful nature and outdoor activities, including sea fishing!
In addition to tents, there are bungalows equipped with air conditioning and car sites, making it easy for outdoor beginners to enjoy camping.
In summer, swimming in the bright blue sea right in front of the campground is very popular! With shallow waters and calm waves, it’s perfect for families with children.
You can also reserve barbecue ingredient sets.
Close to popular tourist destinations in Mie Prefecture such as Ise, Toba, and Shima, this campground is recommended for creating family memories.

Report: Enjoy swimming and sea fishing at Oyodo Fureai Campground! Even outdoor beginners can easily enjoy camping!

title: Maruyama Senmaida (Kumano City, Mie Prefecture) - A Breathtaking Curvilinear Beauty Selected as One of the 'Top 100 Terraced Rice Fields in Japan' | Official Mie Tourism
description:
Maruyama Senmaida (まるやませんまいだ) in Kumano City, Mie Prefecture, is registered as a 'Future Heritage Project' by the Japan UNESCO Association and has also been selected as one of the 'Top 100 Terraced Rice Fields in Japan'.
Beautiful landscapes and tourist attractions are always supported by the presence of people. This time, we visited those involved in the restoration and preservation of 'Maruyama Senmaida' to learn about the beauty behind it.

〇 A breathtaking curvilinear beauty selected as one of the 'Top 100 Terraced Rice Fields in Japan'. A spectacular view 'Maruyama Senmaida' born from nature, protected and passed down by people.

title: 오카야마 일본 전편
description:
일본・오카야마현의 매력적인 관광지를 소개합니다. 오카야마현에는 국가지정 전통적건조물군 보존지구인쿠라시키 미관지구, 일본3대 명정원의 하나인오카야마 고라쿠엔등 많은 관광명소가 있습니다.

~「오카야마 COOL!」을 발신하는 외국어 사이트~
